about: Gun store: a buyer with cash and no firearm permit orders the M9 at the gun counter (the order slip holds one line) and is refused, gets the permit, and the same order is paid; then takes binoculars off the wall shelf, pays at the till on the counter and walks out clean, then takes a compass and walks out unpaid: the clerk's line, the alarm on the shop-front bell box and a wanted level. Points are building space (tools/buildings/pipeline/scenario.mjs); the shop front faces +z.
